tvink.text: TvinK played like someone who never needed a second invitation: upper tier on nearly every count, quick on the trigger, and standing firm when the opposition got serious. The lifetime board and the matchups agreed with each other, which is rarer than it sounds. Quiet since 2022, so this is the legend of how they played, not a forecast — a sharp, busy regular from another season of the game.

tyienbchikdvar.text: tyIenbchikDVAR is a young account already fighting at the very top: matchup rating, activity, and resistance all among the very best, with an unrelenting pace. Accuracy and headshots both sit near the top, though the hardest third trims the edge a little. Early read, but the opening pages are hard to argue with.

tylenbchikdvar.text: tylenbchikDVAR is a young account with a veteran's polish: matchup rating among the very best, activity near the top, and a pace that never slows. The accuracy and headshot share both sit near the top, though the edge softens a touch against the hardest third. The sample behind this one is older and smaller, so treat it as a sketch, with the early-read caveat on top.

tacticaisuperiority.text: TacticaISuperiority plays a complete, high-volume game: relentless output, a game that climbs with the opposition, and a score in the top shelf. Bravery runs near the top, and the game holds up against stronger enemies. Aim is precise, with a strong headshot share. A veteran since 2018, and since the opponent sample behind this one is older and smaller, take it as a sketch rather than a finished portrait.

toxicallyl.text: ToxicAllyl plays a swift, fearless game: the kills coming at a blistering pace, a game that keeps rising with the opposition, and a standing in the top shelf. Consistency runs above average, so the results hold up against the strongest third. Headshots are scarce here, so the body-shot precision carries the load.

ts622.text: TS622 is a young account with an old hand's game: top-shelf across the board, with matchup kill-death numbers among the best and the most precise aim tracked. They pick their moments, the bravery mark sits near the bottom, yet once committed they hold their shape against the hardest opposition. Early read, but the opening pages carry real weight.

thankyouforcoming.text: ThankYouForComing has been at this since 2015, and plays a steady game: perched top shelf, with kill-death tallies up near the top. Tempo holds above average, the accuracy sits above average too, and the headshots land mid-table, as the lifetime IvI number lags a little behind. Still played carefully after a long career.

tolyano.text: TolyaNo has been winning fights since 2014, and the card shows why: rating, activity, bravery, resistance, and matchup kill-death all land near the very top, with a brisk kill pace. The aim stays precise, headshots land near the top, and the lifetime board has them among the very best. Consistency holds mid-pack, the only line that stays ordinary across a long, strong record.

tapext.text: TAPEXT plays fast and hard: tempo and bravery near the very top and resistance right there with them, and a matchup mark that matches. The aim is precise, headshots make up a solid share of attempts, while the lifetime board tells the same story. The one soft line is consistency, sagging against the strongest third — the only crack in an otherwise top-shelf card.

tastytacotreat.text: TastyTacoTreat has been around since 2015, and it shows: a measured pace, bravery well above average, and resistance close to the very top. The matchup mark sits near the top, headshots land at a solid rate, as the lifetime board rates them well above average. Aim is the one middling line, and consistency sits mid-pack — a veteran's card, steady rather than flashy.

terzzz798.text: TerZzz798 is barely weeks into the game and already elite everywhere: rating, activity, bravery, resistance, all of it up near the very top, as the matchup kill-death mark backs it up. Pace is fierce, the aim is sharp, and the edge holds up against the strongest third as well. An early read, but the opening could hardly be louder.

tibetlilc.text: TibeTLilC is a young account off to a flying start: a top-shelf rating, a relentless output, and a game that keeps winning as the enemies get tougher. The consistency mark rests mid-pack, a sign of how fresh the sample still is. Early read, and the opponent sample behind it is older and smaller, so treat this as an early sketch, not the full picture.

tecoedlovs.text: TecoEdloVS plays at full stretch: tempo and bravery both ride high, resistance close behind them; the matchup kill-death mark endures as well. Consistency sits above average, so the edge keeps its shape against the strongest third while the pace never lets up. The lifetime IvI rests in the upper tier too, matching the matchups stride for stride.

tortust.text: Tortust has been playing since 2012, and the game is still sharp: rating and resistance ride in the upper tier, while tempo and bravery trail a half-step behind, plus a matchup kill-death mark that holds its own. Consistency sits below average, and the lifetime IvI lands mid-pack — and the lifetime board undersells the matchups. A veteran whose best work still shows up on the biggest days.

thomasss2011.text: thomasss2011 threads the needle: accuracy sits near the very top while headshots are nearly absent, so the precision comes from body shots. The matchup rating and resistance sit near the top, and a kill-death mark runs high too, while bravery holds the middle. The lifetime board trails far behind the matchups, and consistency dips near the bottom.

terrorclawusnc.text: TerrorClawUSNC is a hammer that keeps swinging: a busy output near the top, plus a game that keeps climbing as enemies improve, and accuracy among the sharpest tracked. The adjusted mark lands near the top, but the lifetime board reaches the same verdict. Consistency runs above average too, so the results hold their shape against the strongest third.
